model_answer: The tyrosine kinase involved in Philadelphia chromosome-positive chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML) that is targeted by Imatinib (Gleevec) is BCR-ABL1. This fusion protein results from the translocation between chromosomes 9 and 22, leading to the formation of the Philadelphia chromosome. Imatinib specifically inhibits the activity of the BCR-ABL1 tyrosine kinase, thereby blocking the signaling pathways that promote the proliferation and survival of leukemic cells.

Imatinib specifically binds to and inhibits the ATP-binding site of the BCR-ABL1 kinase, thereby blocking its oncogenic activity.
